dedupe_keys.name: sao paulo education facilities with geospatial information municipal state and federal school registers

description: Secretaria Municipal de Educação (SME) and SMUL, City of São Paulo publishes the teaching units of the city (municipal EMEI, EMEF, CEU, CEI, CIEJA and MOVA units and others) from the municipal education register, plus the units of the state education secretariat and the federal school census (Educacenso) inside the city, as a zipped geodata file with a data dictionary, viewable in GeoSampa. Coverage: the municipality of São Paulo; the page says it was updated once on 10/12/2024 and the portal record was last modified on 2026-06-11. Format and access: CSV, ODS, ZIP, downloadable without registration from the São Paulo municipal open data portal; the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons CCZero; cost: free. Caveats: the update is a single snapshot, not a maintained series; the zipped geodata file was not opened, so the fields, coordinates quality and unit counts are unconfirmed. Simulation uses: school locations as shelters and critical facilities in flood, landslide and evacuation models, and for accessibility and catchment analysis by district. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
